scope: Owner-approved focused SRR28984805 pilot; not full-cohort or full paper reproduction

requirements.requirement: Reuse validated input and complete real pilot discovery
Assess all proposed junctions against single-transcript and alternative-mapping explanations
Preserve complete RNA ranking and biological unknowns
Reconstruct a bounded batch and verify selected reference-assisted ORFs
Freeze ten distinct sequences before folding and published joins
Maintain a separate published architecture reference control
Measure representative timing and complete one prediction per frozen/control sequence
Verify preserved structures, confidence arrays and visualizations
Compare published evidence only after freeze at its actual grain
Deliver audit tables, FASTAs, diagrams, report and reproducible commands
Preserve outputs and stop temporary workers while retaining controller

limitations: All ten selected hypotheses are single-read reference-assisted sequences from one steady-state sample.
Protein expression and function remain UNKNOWN; structural confidence is not experimental validation.
Selected mean pLDDT ranges from 39.3 to 85.1; control mean is 48.7, so output completion is not a claim of confident folding.
Gsdmd:Tmem106a was not recovered de novo in this bounded pilot; its control is a reference reconstruction matching published constraints, not an author-supplied full-sequence file.
Published gene-pair evidence does not establish exact-junction, sample or protein validation; breakpoint coordinate convention and author structure coordinates remain unavailable.
Full cohort, additional callers, SG-NEx, repeats, optional parent inference and learning remain deferred.
Independent human review is not recorded.
